international.headline: World Knowledge Forum discusses co-intelligence in Seoul
facts: The 27th World Knowledge Forum took place in Seoul, South Korea, from September 8–10, 2026.
Maekyung Media Group organised the forum, whose theme was “The Promethean Moment: Architecting the Co-Intelligence Order.”
Artificial intelligence, co-intelligence and changes in the global economy were among the major discussion areas.
The annual forum brings together political leaders, business executives, academics and technology experts to discuss global issues, economics, innovation and public policy.
international.summary: The forum focused on artificial intelligence, co-intelligence and transformations in the global economy.
international.staticLink: The World Knowledge Forum was launched in 2000.
international.prelimsTakeaway: The 27th forum was held in Seoul under the theme “The Promethean Moment: Architecting the Co-Intelligence Order.”
international.mainsAngle: Consider the economic and public-policy implications of artificial intelligence and human-machine co-intelligence.

international.headline: Google DeepMind launches AlphaGenome Atlas for human DNA analysis
facts: Google DeepMind launched the open-access AlphaGenome Atlas on September 8, 2026.
The Atlas contains around 1 petabyte of data and precomputed AI predictions for approximately 9 billion possible single-letter mutations in human DNA.
It maps coding DNA and non-coding DNA; the notes state that non-coding DNA makes up approximately 98% of the human genome.
The human genome contains approximately 3 billion base pairs; single-letter mutations are also called point mutations or Single-Nucleotide Variants.
international.summary: The Atlas offers an open-access resource for analysing human DNA using precomputed AI predictions across possible mutations.
international.staticLink: DNA carries hereditary information; the Human Genome Project began in 1990 and was completed in 2003.
international.prelimsTakeaway: The Atlas is described as a roughly 1-petabyte database covering predictions for about 9 billion possible single-letter mutations.
international.mainsAngle: AI-enabled genomic resources may support biological research while raising questions about data access, privacy and responsible use.

national.headline: 7th Global FinTech Fest held in Mumbai
facts: The 7th Global FinTech Fest (GFF 2026) took place at Jio World Centre and Trident in Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai, from September 8–11, 2026; Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated it.
Its theme was “Potential to Impact: Agentic AI | Tokenisation | Quantum: Trusted, Connected, Global Systems for Inclusive Finance.”
The Payments Council of India (PCI), National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) and Fintech Convergence Council (FCC) were the principal organisers.
The fest brings attention to digital payments, financial innovation and emerging technologies; its first edition was in 2020.
NPCI was established in 2008, is headquartered in Mumbai and is led by MD & CEO Dilip Asbe.
national.summary: Mumbai hosted the seventh GFF, where participants considered fintech developments and inclusive digital finance under a theme centred on agentic AI, tokenisation and quantum technology.
national.staticLink: Digital payments and financial inclusion in India; role of NPCI in retail payment systems.
national.prelimsTakeaway: GFF 2026 was organised by PCI, NPCI and FCC in Mumbai; NPCI headquarters are in Mumbai.
national.mainsAngle: Assess how emerging fintech technologies can widen financial inclusion while maintaining trusted and secure systems.

andhraPradesh.canonicalTopic: M. Sahithi Varshini earns Woman Grandmaster title
andhraPradesh.headline: Visakhapatnam’s M. Sahithi Varshini earns Woman Grandmaster title
facts: Visakhapatnam chess player M. Sahithi Varshini secured her third and final Woman Grandmaster norm at a tournament in Serbia held from September 8 to 14, 2026.
She scored 6 points from 9 rounds and finished runner-up.
andhraPradesh.summary: M. Sahithi Varshini of Visakhapatnam earned the Woman Grandmaster title after securing her final norm in Serbia.
andhraPradesh.prelimsTakeaway: The notes state that she scored 6/9 and earned the title after her third norm.
andhraPradesh.mainsAngle: The achievement is an example of Andhra Pradesh’s contribution to competitive chess and women’s sport.
andhraPradesh.apLink: The player is identified in the notes as being from Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
